hypothesis: Repair options_forward daily settlement wiring so default-off options candidate rows can accumulate closed OHLCV outcomes without requiring a manual OPTIONS_FORWARD_OHLCV_SNAPSHOT env var.
alpha_hypothesis_context: Options structure tags may eventually explain candidate quality or slot conflicts, but prior options alpha was rejected and this run only repaired the forward-row settlement blocker.

reflection.why_result_happened: The daily runner had already wired the options forward ledger, but the builder only accepted a JSON OHLCV snapshot. The current local snapshots stop before most May-July 2026 option-chain rows, while warehouse_main.sqlite has PIT OHLCV through 2026-06-15. Adding a warehouse loader and daily fallback converts the ledger from all missing outcomes to partially settled forward rows.
reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retune squeeze/downside options overlays or promote them from these 9-14 closed scoring-allowed outcomes. This is a measurement repair, not an alpha acceptance.
reflection.new_evidence_required: Next options alpha requires materially more settled forward rows, ideally after warehouse OHLCV extends beyond 2026-06-15, then a shared-paper-first Gate 1-4 evaluation against the accepted baseline.
